sources.name: Exophase
sources.role: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades

sources.name: OutputLag
sources.role: Missable warning and chapter / save advice

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. [1][2] The full road runs about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, in one playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. [3][4]
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Gone Fishing through to its end. [1][3] It is one of the opening missions, so it comes naturally in Stage 1 of the roadmap. [3]
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. [1][3] Keep a manual save at the start and the end of the chapter: the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. [3][4]
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. [1][3] Save at the start and end of the chapter, keeping separate saves as backup. [3][4]
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. [1][3] In Chapter 3, do Race Against Yago the moment it appears: it is time-sensitive and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. [3]
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. [1][3] Near the end of Chapter 4, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vaults, so do it before moving on. [3]
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. [1][3] Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and the save is your only way back. [3][4]
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end. [1][3] Story mission trophies pop as you play the chapters in order. [3]
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every row of the 100% checklist in this guide, tracked in game under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. [1][3] The checklist only appears in game after the story, but work done earlier counts. [3] This is the long grind of Stage 2, about 100 hours. [3]
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. [1][2] For 100% you need 300 of the 397 stunts in the game, so keep going past this trophy toward the checklist total. [3] Stunts count in free roam after the story. [3]
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. [1][3] Do them as they unlock during the story in Stage 1, so none is left for cleanup. [3]
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. [1][2] All 42 golds are also a row of the 100% checklist, so this trophy and that row finish together. [3]
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. [1][3] There are 42 Drone Time Trials in total, and all 42 are a 100% checklist row. [3]
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. [1][2] For 100% you need 30 of the 40 races won, plus 10 of the 13 Race Challenge golds, so keep racing past this trophy. [3]
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. [1][3] Fishing is one of the activity types, so try it when it unlocks in Stage 1. [3]
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. [1][3] Arcades are one of the activity types; a single completed game is enough. [3]
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. [1][3] Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but its finale is still a trophy of its own. [3]
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. [1][3] Kenton's strand stays open after the story, so finish it in Stage 3 cleanup. [3]
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. [1][3] Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but its finale is still a trophy of its own. [3]
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. [1][3] Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward this trophy, so the 8 must come from the other stranger strands. [3] In Chapter 3, do Race Against Yago the moment it appears: it is time-sensitive and its strand counts here. [3]
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. [1][3] Randy's strand stays open after the story, so finish it in Stage 3 cleanup. [3]
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand. [1][3] Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but its finale is still a trophy of its own. [3]
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. [1][3] Spots show as purple icons when you are close; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner along. [3][4] The missable step: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. [3][4] Both guides agree it is gone after Chapter 1, so do it before leaving Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. [3][4]
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE: KeenGamer and OutputLag agree the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. [3][4]
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. [1][3] Study animals with binoculars from the start of the game: 100 animals studied is a 100% checklist row, and the hunting habit pays off here. [3]
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. [1][2] For 100% you need 15 of the 18 card sets, so keep collecting past this trophy. [3]
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. [1][2] Start WAiNK-scanning from the beginning of the game: all 100 locations are also a 100% checklist row. [3]
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. [1][2] For 100% you need 70 of the 80 challenges, so keep going past this trophy toward the checklist total. [3]
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops and escape. [1][3] Do it with your partner present: the trophy needs the pair together, not a solo escape. [3]
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level in between. [1][3] Plan the route first and keep the heat on: dropping the Wanted Level breaks the chain. [3]
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. [1][2] For 100% you need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so scan vehicles with WAiNK from the start of the game and keep going past this trophy. [3]
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. [1][3] Wait for a fight with a group clustered together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends. [3]
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from VCIA and take off in it. [1][3] Board while it is preparing to leave, get it moving, and lift off: that unscheduled departure is the trophy. [3]
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and use it in combat. [1][3] Get the tank moving and take part in a fight with it: the trophy is for using the Rhino, not just sitting in it. [3]
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without triggering detection. [1][3] In Chapter 3 the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs helps with jewelry robberies, so time this one after that unlock. [3]
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. [1][2] Bank vaults unlock with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4, and all 8 vaults are a 100% checklist row, so keep going past this trophy. [3]
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. [1][3] Hit the truck, take the cash, and break away clean: the escape is part of the trophy. [3]
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. [1][3] Visit every corner of the map in free roam after the story; the in-game map shows which areas are still unvisited. [3]
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. [1][3] There are 39 Gang Operations in total for the 100% checklist, so this trophy is the first pass through them. [3]
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description is all PlayStation gives: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. [1] No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19/11/2026, so this entry lists no steps rather than inventing them. [1][3]
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official description is all PlayStation gives: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. [1] No published guide has confirmed the exact method as of 19/11/2026, so this entry lists no steps rather than inventing them. [1][3]
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape. [1][3] Get in, take all three valuables, and get out clean: the follow-through is the escape. [3]
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. [1][3] Train both characters up: the trophy is about the partnership, so one maxed stat alone is not enough. [3]
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. [1][3] Ordinary play builds the count over time; check your Criminal Profile to see it climb toward 500. [3]
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The official description is all PlayStation gives: second time's the charm. [1] No published guide has confirmed the exact method as of 19/11/2026, so this entry lists no steps rather than inventing them. [1][3]
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The official description is all PlayStation gives: what the hell just happened? [1] No published guide has confirmed the exact method as of 19/11/2026, so this entry lists no steps rather than inventing them. [1][3]
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. [1][3] Line up a group on foot, drive past at speed, and swing as you pass. [3]
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. [1][2] Marked Bills come from robberies, so this trophy builds up alongside the robbery grind in Stage 2. [3]
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. [1][2] Big purchases count fastest: vehicles, weapons and property spending all adds up toward the total. [3]
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. [1][3] Buy them as you can afford them; garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot. [3]
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. [1][3] Any vehicles you own count: register them through the app as you collect them. [3]
trophies.name: On the Spot
